description.value: Natureway Farm Market is a fresh produce and specialty food market in Port Coquitlam offering fruits, vegetables, meat, seafood, dairy, frozen foods, and a wide range of international grocery products spanning Asian, European, and Americas selections. It operates both as a physical store with seven-days-a-week local pickup and as an online ordering platform serving the Metro Vancouver area. Touring cyclists passing through the Tri-Cities corridor would find a well-stocked stop for fresh produce and packaged resupply goods.
